All the payload validation logic is moved to the Serializer. When the payload is loaded into a `TriggerDAGRunPostBody` object, it should be valid as is without further validation/manipulation.

This closes: [46650#issuecomment-2654340014](https://github.com/apache/airflow/issues/46650#issuecomment-2654340014)

issue_context.title: Make run_after non public and move validation logic for the payloas to the Serializer
issue_context.body:
Make run_after non-public. 

I think we need to make run_after non public. Feels like we should not expose this to the user as an option -- but rather, it's something that the scheduler should figure out based on the dag / dag run.

_Originally posted by @dstandish in https://github.com/apache/airflow/issues/46616#issuecomment-2651110552_
comments: While changing API also take care of [46512#discussion_r1951222852](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/46512#discussion_r1951222852)

> While changing API also take care of [46512#discussion_r1951222852](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/46512#discussion_r1951222852)

Second part is being taken care in this PR: [46882](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/46882)

review_comments: You can make this a `@model_validator(mode="after")`, this way it's automatically called after `TriggerDAGRunPostBody` is deserialized and instanciated. You won't have to remember to call that manually.
That is correct, but here, data_interval is not part of the body. How can that be accessed?
I missed that, I guess we can't
